server.jobs.checkCatalogueConnectivity.d: Verifies the configured catalogue key can actually reach the catalogue.
server.jobs.checkDiskSpace.description: Asks how much room is left on the filesystems Valence writes to, so a disk about to fill is something an operator hears about rather than something a scan discovers.
server.jobs.checkDiskSpace.label: Check disk space
server.jobs.checkRequests.description: Asks the requests service whether it is still answering, and whether the VPN it downloads through is up, so an operator hears about either going quiet from a notification.
server.jobs.checkRequests.label: Check the requests service
server.jobs.checkTranscoder.description: Asks the transcoder whether it is still answering, so an operator hears about it going quiet from a notification rather than from somebody pressing play.
server.jobs.checkTranscoder.label: Check the transcoder
server.jobs.cleanupArtefactCache.descrip: Removes preview clips and scrub previews nothing addresses any more, freeing the space left behind by a reset or a change to how they are made.
server.jobs.cleanupArtefactCache.label: Clean up cached previews
server.jobs.cleanupImageCache.descriptio: Removes cached artwork and profile photos nothing references any more, and the kept pages of books nobody has opened for 30 days.
server.jobs.cleanupImageCache.label: Clean up cached images
server.jobs.cleanupSessions.description: Clears out expired sign-in sessions and device-authorization codes.
server.jobs.cleanupSessions.label: Clean up sessions
server.jobs.clearLibraryParts.descriptio: Erases the chosen parts of a library, such as descriptions, artwork, trailers or preview clips, then fetches or makes them again from scratch. Everything else is left alone.
server.jobs.clearLibraryParts.label: Clear and fetch again
server.jobs.clearOldDownloads.descriptio: Deletes files prepared for keeping once they have gone unasked for as long as the server keeps them. A device that already fetched one keeps its copy.
server.jobs.clearOldDownloads.label: Clear out old downloads
server.jobs.detectSegments.description: Finds the intro and the recap in each episode by comparing the audio across a season, so viewers can skip them. Skips seasons already done.
server.jobs.detectSegments.label: Detect missing intros and outros
server.jobs.fetchLogos.description: Collects the lettering each title is written in, so a hero shows the programme's own logo rather than its name set in the interface's typeface. Skips items that already have one, and items no catalogue has named.
server.jobs.fetchLogos.label: Fetch missing logos
server.jobs.interrupted: The server restarted while this was running, so it was stopped.
server.jobs.pruneHistory.description: Forgets viewings older than a year. What each profile has watched recently stays; the rest is removed, because this log grows every evening and nobody reads back that far.
server.jobs.pruneHistory.label: Prune old viewing history
server.jobs.pruneJobHistory.description: Forgets job runs older than thirty days, and the per-item issues recorded against them.
server.jobs.pruneJobHistory.label: Prune old job history
server.jobs.pruneLogs.description: Forgets log records past the age their level is kept for, so errors outlive the ordinary chatter. A retention policy nobody enforces is a table that grows until the disk fills.
server.jobs.pruneLogs.label: Prune old log records
server.jobs.pruneResourceHistory.descrip: Forgets server load samples older than a week.
server.jobs.pruneResourceHistory.label: Prune old server load history
server.jobs.pruneWebhookDeliveries.descr: Forgets what was sent to webhook subscribers more than a week ago. Recent deliveries stay, so a receiver that has started failing is still visible; the rest goes, because this table gains a row for every event sent to everybody.
server.jobs.pruneWebhookDeliveries.label: Prune old webhook deliveries
server.jobs.reencode.description: Produces the encodes an administrator asked for, one file at a time. Each replacement waits for somebody to watch it and say it is fine before the original is disposed of, so this pauses rather than continuing once too many are waiting to be judged.
server.jobs.reencode.label: Work through the re-encoding queue
server.jobs.refreshRequests.description: Asks the catalogue again about every film not yet fetched and every series still running, so a new episode is wanted the day it is announced and a film is held until the release date it has now.
server.jobs.refreshRequests.label: Bring requests up to date with the catalogue
server.jobs.regeneratePreviews.descripti: Renders preview clips for items that have none, using each library's forced audio language. Skips items that already have one.
server.jobs.regeneratePreviews.label: Generate missing previews
server.jobs.regenerateTrickplay.descript: Renders the strip of images shown when scrubbing the seek bar, for items that have none. Skips items that already have one.
server.jobs.regenerateTrickplay.label: Generate missing scrub previews
server.jobs.resetLibrary.description: Deletes every item in every library and starts again from nothing: scanning, then everything each item needs made for it. Hours of work on a large library.
server.jobs.resetLibrary.label: Reset and rebuild
server.jobs.scanLibrary.description: Finds new, changed and removed files, then makes whatever they are still missing.
server.jobs.scanLibrary.label: Scan for changes
server.jobs.sendMediaDigest.description: Collects what has been imported since the last time and says it once, so a scan of four hundred files is one notification rather than four hundred.
server.jobs.sendMediaDigest.label: Tell the household about new media
